description: New York City Department of Finance sales files for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ny-nyc-dof-sales.md.

sources.publisher: New York City Department of Finance
sources.license: Public record published by DOF on nyc.gov and on NYC Open Data (usep-8jbt rolling, w2pb-icbu annualized) under the NYC Open Data Law (Admin. Code §23-502). The NYC Open Data FAQ states: 'Open Data belongs to all New Yorkers. There are no restrictions on the use of Open Data.' The nyc.gov Terms of Use govern website use and state no data license
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; the FAQ states there are no restrictions on the use of Open Data
sources.redistribution: Permitted: 'no restrictions on the use of Open Data' (FAQ). Attribution: New York City Department of Finance
sources.notes: Rolling sales (tax classes 1, 2 and 4, the last twelve months: October 2025 - September 2026 on 2026-11-04) and the annualized calendar-year files for 2025 and 2024, one workbook per borough; earlier years back to 2003 are on the annualized page (the 2023 URLs follow the same pattern). The files name no buyer, seller or other party and give no arm's-length flag. Load the rolling files with --since 2026-01-01 so the October-December 2025 sales are not loaded twice. robots.txt on www.nyc.gov disallows only /html/misc/.
